name: xitl-mcp
description: X in the Loop: an MCP proxy that puts a human (or a reviewer agent) in front of every tool call

scripts.build: npm run build:web && npm run build:api
scripts.test:unit: npm --workspace @xitl/api run test:unit && npm --workspace @xitl/web run test:unit

comment:overrides: typescript: Prisma 7 pulls in typescript@7 and npm hoists it to the root, where svelte-check (which only supports TS <=6) would pick it up and crash. Pin the whole tree to the newest TS the Svelte toolchain supports (6.x). better-sqlite3: the @prisma/adapter-better-sqlite3 driver adapter needs ^12.6.0, but prisma's optional better-sqlite3 peer (>=9.0.0) makes npm auto-install a second, newer copy at the root, so two native modules compile in the image. Pin the tree to the adapter's 12.x line. (Copied from haushalts-todos, which copied it from rezepte.)
